responsibility: Declares the lightweight error-reporting API for GCC build-time generator programs. It exposes plain warning, error, fatal, and internal_error routines, along with progname, have_error, and trim_filename, distinguishing this generator-oriented interface from the richer compiler diagnostics declared in diagnostic-core.h and diagnostic.h.
same_name_distinction: Header for the lightweight generator-side errors pair: it exposes the simple warning/error/fatal/internal_error interface and shared state declarations, while errors.cc contains the actual plain-message implementation used by host generator programs.
